{{Quote|Mandalore helped the Sith find Dramath's hidden crypt. The Sith took the remains to give to his master, and in exchange he told Mandalore of a vision his Master had had of the Mandalorians rising up and defeating the Republic.|Revan, telling Canderous Ordo about the search|<ref name="Revan" />}}
Around [[3978 BBY]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]&mdash;the leader of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]&mdash;sent an [[Unidentified Sith emissary|emissary]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to '''search''' for the [[Skeleton/Legends|remains]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath the Second]], the enemy of the [[Emissary/Legends|emissary's]] master, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. The emissary was tasked with [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|convincing]] [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors, to help in the search. After Mandalore helped the emissary find Dramath's remains on the remote planet of [[Rekkiad]], the emissary told Mandalore of a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] his master had of the Mandalorians [[Mandalorian Wars|rising up and defeating]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to manipulate Mandalore into invading the Republic.

==Prelude==
Around [[3978 BBY]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]&mdash;the leader of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]&mdash;chose a<ref name="Revan" /> [[Unidentified Sith emissary|Sith Lord]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> to act as his [[Emissary/Legends|emissary]] to the current [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], the leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors, [[Mandalore the Ultimate]]. The [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] also had the emissary search for the [[Skeleton/Legends|remains]] of his enemy [[Dramath the Second]]. The emissary traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Mandalorians, and convinced Mandalore to help in the search for Dramath's remains.<ref name="Revan" />

==The search==
The journey led the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] emissary and Mandalore to the remote planet of [[Rekkiad]], where they discovered that [[Dramath the Second's tomb]] was inside the [[First Spear]] of the [[Twin Spears]], a pair of columns of [[Water/Legends|ice]] several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] tall. Inside the tomb they found [[Dramath the Second's sarcophagus|Dramath's sarcophagus]] filled with his remains and a [[Dramath the Second's datacron|datacron]] he had created.<ref name="Revan" />

==Aftermath==
The Sith emissary took the remains back to his master. In exchange for Mandalore's help in finding the remains, the emissary told Mandalore of a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] his master had of the Mandalorians [[Mandalorian Wars|rising up and defeating]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While spinning the tale he cast a [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|spell]] on Mandalore, manipulating him into invading the Republic and testing the Republic's strength.<ref name="Revan" /> [[3976 BBY|Two years later]], the Mandalorians went on to invade the Republic.<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] joined the war after discovering the atrocities of the [[Battle of Cathar]], turning the tide back in the Republic's favor. In [[3960 BBY|three years]] Revan went on to win the war at the [[Battle of Malachor V]].<ref name="EGtW" /> In [[3954 BBY]], Revan told [[Canderous Ordo]], a Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who became the new Mandalore, the truth about how the Mandalorian Wars really began.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The search for Dramath the Second's remains was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
